summary: plan dry-run for repos branches ssh tls
pull_request_body: This change makes 24 repos, branches, ssh and tls commands obey the dry-run rule (#412). Nine commands that make an external request get a request plan: their --dry-run makes no request and returns the ordered PlannedRequest items built from the same argument builder as the real run. Fifteen commands that make no external request get the no-external-request class, so devops --dry-run runs them normally. Echo-only previews are removed with no shim. Each command is removed from tests/fixtures/dry_run_gaps.json. The work uses the existing PlannedRequest, render_request_plan, and the dry-run class decorator from sub-issue 00. No new dependency is added.
why: Issue #2258 (part of #886) reports that 24 repos, branches, ssh and tls commands do not obey the dry-run rule (#412). Nine make an external request under --dry-run or have no request plan. Fifteen print a generic line or an argument echo instead of running safely. The owner's rule says a dry run makes no external request and returns the requests a real run would make.
what_changes: Add the request-plan class and a --dry-run that returns ordered PlannedRequest items to 9 commands (branches sync, branches update, repos clone, repos clone-org, repos sync, repos update, ssh register, ssh rotate, tls enable-k8s).

Add the no-external-request class to 15 commands (branches clean, branches jira, branches list, repos list, repos worktrees prune, repos worktrees status, ssh audit, ssh generate, ssh list, ssh status, tls ca, tls cert, tls homelab, tls inspect, tls verify).
Remove echo-only --dry-run previews (render_dry_run_result or @dry_run_command) from the 9 request-plan commands and from ssh list, with no shim.
Remove all 24 command paths from tests/fixtures/dry_run_gaps.json so the ratchet test passes.
Write tests that verify no external request is made, the plan matches the real run, and mark-only commands run normally under --dry-run.
feasibility: The premise is confirmed by the #886 inventory (2026-10-25, commit 1bb164bd) and the fixture file tests/fixtures/dry_run_gaps.json, which lists all 24 commands.
The dry-run infrastructure exists: devops_cli.dry_run.requests.PlannedRequest and render_request_plan are referenced in CHANGELOG.md (#741, #885).
The test guards in tests/conftest.py (network guard, process guard, keyring deny) are in place and will catch any unfaked external reach.
The dry-run class decorator and ratchet test come from sub-issue 00, a stated dependency.

First checks the implementation runs: (1) uv run devops ci test tests/test_roadmap_dry_runs.py to confirm the ratchet test currently fails for these 24 commands; (2) uv run devops branches sync --dry-run to confirm the current generic output; (3) uv run devops ssh list --dry-run to confirm the echo-only preview.
existing_tool: The repository already provides devops_cli.dry_run.requests.PlannedRequest, render_request_plan (#741), the dry-run class decorator, and the ratchet test from sub-issue 00. The test guards in tests/conftest.py and the pattern in tests/test_roadmap_dry_runs.py cover the verification. No new dependency is necessary.

decisions.decision: Build each PlannedRequest from the same argument builder the real run uses
decisions.reason: The issue states the plan cannot drift from the run. Using the same builder guarantees the plan matches the real requests.

decisions.decision: Remove echo-only previews with no shim
decisions.reason: The issue says 'with no shim' and the pre-1.0 policy in the repository deletes rather than keeps behind flags.

decisions.decision: Group commands by family and work type (mark-only vs request-plan)
decisions.reason: Each group fits the 40000-token budget. A group of 2-5 commands in one file keeps the step small and focused.

decisions.decision: Use the existing PlannedRequest and render_request_plan
decisions.reason: They exist in the repository (#741) and are the established pattern. Building new rendering would duplicate code.

rejected.alternative: Build a new dry-run rendering module for these commands
rejected.evidence: render_request_plan and PlannedRequest already exist (#741, #885 in CHANGELOG.md). Building a new one duplicates code and diverges from the established pattern.

rejected.alternative: Keep echo-only previews as a fallback behind a flag
rejected.evidence: The issue says 'with no shim'. The pre-1.0 policy in the repository (ADR 0005, CONTEXT.md) deletes rather than keeps behind flags.

rejected.alternative: Add a new dependency for dry-run planning
rejected.evidence: The issue states 'No new dependency is necessary.' The repository already has the full dry-run infrastructure.

added.name: request-plan-dry-run-returns-planned-requests
added.text: A command with the request-plan class SHALL make no external request under --dry-run and SHALL return its real result type marked as a dry run with the ordered PlannedRequest items.

scenarios.name: dry-run makes no external request
scenarios.when: a request-plan command is invoked with --dry-run and the process runner and HTTP clients are patched to raise
scenarios.then: the command completes without raising and the output lists the ordered PlannedRequest items with argv, stdin, env, condition and repeat

scenarios.name: dry-run returns real result type as json
scenarios.when: a request-plan command is invoked with --dry-run and --format json
scenarios.then: the JSON output has the dry-run mark and the planned requests array in order

added.name: no-external-request-runs-normally
added.text: A command with the no-external-request class SHALL run normally under devops --dry-run.

scenarios.name: dry-run runs the command
scenarios.when: a no-external-request command is invoked under devops --dry-run with the process runner and HTTP clients patched to raise
scenarios.then: the command completes and returns its normal result without a dry-run mark

added.name: request-plan-matches-real-run
added.text: The PlannedRequest items of a request-plan dry run SHALL match the requests the real run makes, in the same order.

scenarios.name: plan matches recorded calls
scenarios.when: a test runs the real command against a fake runner or client that records each call and compares the calls with the plan
scenarios.then: the recorded calls match the PlannedRequest items in order with the same argv, stdin and env
